```yaml
name: GPU Reset Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: rocm/pytorch:latest
      options: --gpus all

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install torch torchvision torchaudio
        pip install pytest
        pip install numpy

    - name: Run Gluon all-gather tests
      run: |
        python -m pytest test_all_gather_gluon.py -v

    - name: Run existing Triton all-gather tests
      run: |
        python -m pytest test_all_gather_triton.py -v

    - name: Verify no regressions
      run: |
        python -c "
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
from shmem.ccl import all_gather

# Basic functionality test
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    print('CUDA available')
    # Test basic all-gather functionality
    tensor = torch.randn(1024, 1024, device='cuda')
    result = all_gather(tensor, use_gluon=True)
    print(f'Gluon all-gather successful: {result.shape}')
else:
    print('CUDA not available')
"
```
